meta.title: 한반도 곤충 도감
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (한반도 곤충 도감 개정판, a field guide to Korean insects re-engraved on copper (fictional book)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 한반도 곤충 도감 개정판, a field guide to Korean insects re-engraved on copper (fictional book)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Copperplate printing: plate paper #F3EEE2 with a plate mark and the faint plate tone left by wiping, ink #1C1A17 in lines only (no fills), and hand colouring last in a few watercolour washes: brown #7A4524 and amber for the beetle, yellow #E2B53A, blue #3D6FA8 and red #B5372B for the butterfly and the ladybird.
rationale.type: Nanum Myeongjo ExtraBold for the engraved titles and names, revealed behind the burin; Diphylleia, a light serif, for plate numbers and small captions, like the italic legends of old plates.
rationale.motion: Engraving order is the motion: outlines, then limbs, then hatching layer by layer, each line cut along its length with a glint at the burin; magnification roundels spring open on a detail; washes bloom from a point with a ragged, darker edge. Slow pushes and a light sliding across the lens keep finished plates alive.
rationale.sound: Corporate at 112 BPM in G major on recorded instruments (VCSL and VSCO 2 CE, CC0): a violin section bed, a harpsichord playing broken eighths, cello pizzicato bass, a solo violin hook and glockenspiel in the drop, no kit but a shaker; burin scrapes (engrave) on the lines, ticks for labels, a soft swell for each wash.
rationale.visuals: All code: every line is a filled strip whose width swells along it and scales with the tone it carries; domes are hatched along meridians or parallels with the width taken from a lit ellipsoid, so highlights appear where the lines thin, and a crossing family is added in deep shade; dark wing bands are dense crossing hatch clipped to the band; the insects are built from these parts in their own coordinates.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the plates speak for themselves.
